name: @omp-dev-team/dev-team
description: Dev-team plugin manifest for Oh-My-Pi. Declares the blocking-guard extensions (plan-gate, review-gate, path/freeze/spec guards, the .NET build gate) so a marketplace install loads them; agents/skills/commands/.mcp.json are discovered by their conventional sibling directories.
comment: v2.0.0: model-routing.ts (the effort-band resolver) is retired - upstream ADT deleted the equivalent machinery in ADR-0026 in favour of the harness's own model/effort resolution, and OMP resolves modelRoles + role aliases natively. serena-enforce.ts is retired too: OMP ships an `lsp` tool with definition/references/symbols/hover/rename/code_actions and auto-detects omnisharp for C#, so an unconditional deny on native .cs writes bought nothing and hard-required an external MCP. serena-build-net.ts stays - nothing native blocks session end on a red build.
